description: Several nested plastic bowls sit on a dark blue bedspread in front of a pale pink pillow. The left hand reaches forward to the stack, lifts the top bowl off, and slides it to the right to set it down; it then removes another bowl and places it in front, moves a larger bowl to the far right, and finally pulls a smaller bowl out and sets it down near the front-left, while the right hand stays nearby without touching any bowl.
